headline: OJK Begins Data Collection on Investors Eligible for Compensation in Stock Manipulation Case
summary: Indonesia's financial services authority OJK has started compiling data on investors entitled to receive refunds from illegal gains tied to share price manipulation.
why: The OJK, Indonesia's financial services authority, supervises capital markets and enforces rules against market manipulation that affect investor confidence.
original_headline: OJK Mulai Data Investor Penerima Ganti Rugi Manipulasi Saham
